donate.title: Donate
donate.intro: AIS Alumni is run by a volunteer committee of graduates. Donations pay for running the association — the app and its servers, reunions and events.
donate.note: The AIS Alumni Committee is a voluntary association, so donations aren't tax-deductible. Payments are handled securely by Stripe; your card details never reach the committee.

install.title: Beta test the app
install.intro: We're getting the AIS Alumni iPhone app ready for the App Store. Before it's released, we're looking for testers to try the beta and tell us what they find. You join the beta through Apple's TestFlight app (free).
steps: Tap “Join the beta in TestFlight” below.
Open “AIS Alumni” on your Home Screen, sign in the same way as on the web (email code or LINE), and use it as you normally would.
Tell us about bugs or anything awkward with “Send Beta Feedback” in TestFlight, or Contact us in the app.
install.storeIntro: The AIS Alumni iPhone app is on the App Store.
install.notReady: The beta isn't open yet. You'll be able to join from here when it starts.
install.lineNote: TestFlight may not open from LINE's in-app browser. Choose “Open in Safari” from the menu at the bottom right (or top right), then try again.
notes: A beta is still in development, so it may have bugs. New beta versions arrive through the TestFlight app.
Once the app is on the App Store, you'll be able to install it straight from this page.
An Android version is on the way. Until then, please use this web version.

prompt.title: Try the app's beta
prompt.body: Join the beta test before the App Store release and tell us what you think.

benefits.title: What the app can do
items: Notice chats and announcements without opening email or LINE.
Shows what you last saw straight away — even with a weak signal.
Answer a chat or accept a follow request without opening the app.
Sign in with LINE in a tap
The LINE app opens and you just confirm.
Bring up your event ticket in a tap.
